name: Bee Yard Wingman
notes: 👥 My club (on Home): join your club with its code, read club announcements, and choose which yards to share. The club only ever gets counts, never where your yards are.
Club leaders see the club's numbers, who might need a hand, and members' licenses. Club printouts are inside My club now.
🧪 Try the practice club to see how it all works, even with no signal.
